import numpy as np
def equation(t, P, params):
    a,b,c,g,n,d,e,f,h,k=params[0],params[1],params[2],params[3],params[4],params[5],params[6],params[7],params[8],params[9]
    H=np.abs(t)**n/(np.abs(d)**n+np.abs(t)**n)
    return a*P + b*P*np.log(P) + c*P**2 - g*H + e*P*np.exp(-f*t) + h*P*H + k*P**3
